refresh:ready.description: Refresh rendered its interface and the intents of other modules: {schema, source_module, version, context}

refresh:list-rendered.description: a ticket list was rendered (page load or view switched in place): {schema, source_module, mailbox_id, view}

refresh:conversation-rendered.description: a ticket page was rendered: {schema, source_module, conversation_id, mailbox_id, mobile}

fsinterop.sla.targets.description: Refresh answers with its SLA targets (Manage > Settings > Refresh), unless another module answered first

fsinterop.modules.description: Refresh adds its summary (id, name, version, protocol, capabilities)
